note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸列，課程模板沒有；金額不為零時才顯示，並標「模板無此列」。
note.en: An extension line added by the site; the course template has no such line. It is shown only when the amount is non-zero, marked as not in the template.

definition.zh-TW:
償還長期借款本金時付出的現金。

這是籌資活動的流出：現金與非流動負債同時減少；利息不在這裡，另外列在支付利息(-)。
definition.en:
Cash paid to repay the principal of a long-term loan.

It is a financing outflow: cash and non-current liabilities fall together; the interest is shown separately on interest paid (-).

example.zh-TW: 位置：現金流量表籌資活動區。本課故事沒有長期借款，所以用不到。
example.en: Where it sits: the financing activities section of the statement of cash flows. The course story has no long-term borrowing, so it is not used.

misconception.zh-TW: 把還本金當成費用、以為會讓淨利減少。還本只是把負債和現金一起消掉，不經過損益表；會進損益表的只有利息。
misconception.en: Treating the principal repayment as an expense that lowers profit. Repaying principal simply cancels a liability against cash and never touches the income statement; only the interest does.
